description: The donut chart illustrates the distribution of content types within the Darija Open Dataset (DODa) Version 2, as presented in the paper “The Evolution of Darija Open Dataset Introducing Version 2.” The chart is segmented into five distinct categories, each represented by a colored slice with its corresponding numerical value displayed inside: “Translated Sentences” (yellow, 45,387), “Pending Translations” (light green, 43,000), “Extra + Augmented Data” (blue-gray, 30,000), “Syntactic Roles (e.g., Verbs, Nouns, Adjectives)” (orange-brown, 23,108), and “Semantic Categories (e.g., Food, Economy)” (purple, a very thin slice with no visible number). A legend on the right identifies each category by color and label, including “Moroccan Names” (orange-red), though this category is not visibly represented in the chart with a labeled slice. The segments are arranged clockwise starting from the top-right, with the largest segment (“Translated Sentences”) occupying the top-right quadrant and the smallest visible segment (“Semantic Categories”) appearing as a narrow sliver between “Pending Translations” and “Syntactic Roles.” The chart uses a 3D effect and a central hole, typical of donut charts, to visually separate and emphasize the proportional contribution of each content type to the overall dataset.
